This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Three reload methods separate beginners from skilled shooters. Emergency reloads happen under fire—speed is everything. Tactical reloads prepare you during quiet moments with a full magazine ready. Retention reloads are slower but safer, keeping every round available. Firearm instructors mix terminology, but all three solve the same problem: staying in the fight. #simplehistory
